jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Vividly** is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

The Implementation team at Vividly plays a critical role in turning a customer's solution design into a successful, operational Vividly experience.

Our Implementation Managers are both **hands-on platform configurators and end-to-end project managers**. They take an approved solution design and translate it into Vividly configuration, customer workflows, data setup, training, testing, and ultimately go-live.

Implementation Managers serve as the primary point of contact throughout onboarding, coordinating across customers, Solution Architecture, Integrations, Managed Services, Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to keep complex projects moving forward.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, understanding complex workflows, configuring software, managing multiple moving pieces, and creating an onboarding experience that gives customers confidence they made the right investment.

**Who You Are**

You are an energetic, curious, and highly accountable implementation professional who enjoys being in front of customers as much as you enjoy getting into the details of how a platform should be configured.

You're comfortable taking an approved solution design, understanding the business intent behind it, and turning it into something real. You can work through complex business workflows, translate requirements into accurate platform configuration, work confidently with customer data, and explain how the resulting experience will work for the people using it.

You're also a strong project manager. You can manage multiple implementations at once, keep customers and internal teams accountable, identify dependencies before they become blockers, and create momentum without sacrificing quality.

You don't need to design every solution from scratch, but you do need to understand the solution you're implementing. You ask questions when something doesn't make sense, recognize when customer requirements have materially changed, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and know when to bring Solution Architecture back into the conversation before changes create unnecessary complexity, scope creep, or rework.

Most importantly, you bring energy to the customer experience. You're engaged, passionate about helping customers succeed, comfortable leading a room, and genuinely enjoy seeing customers move from complicated processes to confidently operating in Vividly.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end implementation project for assigned customers, from post-Solution Alignment through configuration, training, UAT, go-live, and transition.
* Serve as the primary project manager and day-to-day customer lead throughout onboarding, owning timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, customer actions, and overall project health.
* Translate approved Solution Architecture designs into accurate, scalable Vividly platform configuration.
* Configure customer workflows, master data, promotion structures, deduction-related settings, reporting requirements, user access, and other applicable platform components based on the approved solution.
* Understand the business purpose behind the configuration, not simply the individual fields or settings being configured.
* Prepare, transform, import, map, and validate customer datasets, including customer, product, pricing, revenue, and other applicable data.
* Validate configured workflows against the approved solution design and expected customer experience before progressing into training, UAT, and go-live.
* Lead customer implementation meetings with confidence, clear direction, and strong follow-through.
* Hold customers and internal stakeholders accountable to agreed actions, decisions, and timelines.
* Proactively identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and decisions that could impact scope, timeline, or customer readiness and drive them toward resolution.
* Coordinate cross-functional onboarding workstreams, including Integrations and Managed Services, while maintaining visibility into dependencies that impact the overall implementation.
* Deliver initial platform and workflow training to establish customer operational readiness and prepare users to begin successfully working in Vividly.
* Guide customers through UAT and confirm that configured workflows operate as intended before go-live.
* Assess customer readiness across configuration, data, training, integrations, services dependencies, and outstanding customer actions.
* Complete structured handoffs to Customer Success and Managed Services, ensuring important customer context, business outcomes, decisions, risks, and outstanding actions carry forward after implementation.
* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams when additional expertise is required.
* Identify recurring implementation challenges and contribute to improving our playbooks, templates, automation, processes, and overall customer onboarding experience.

**Solution Design & Change Management**

Implementation Managers execute against an approved solution design while maintaining enough business and product context to recognize when that design may need to be revisited.

In this role, you will:

* Use the approved Solution Architecture design as the source of truth for configuration and implementation execution.
* Understand the business requirements, assumptions, decisions, and intended customer experience behind the solution you're implementing.
* Recognize when newly discovered requirements or customer requests materially differ from the approved design.
* Challenge assumptions when a requested change could introduce unnecessary complexity, downstream risk, or significant rework.
* Distinguish between configuration decisions you can independently make and material solution changes that require Solution Architecture to re-engage.
* Escalate material design changes, new requirements, scope changes, or unresolved solution questions before changing the approved design.
* Document implementation decisions and ensure material changes are reflected in the appropriate solution and project documentation.
* Help customers move toward scalable future-state workflows rather than automatically recreating legacy processes simply because that's how they've historically operated.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3–5+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, implementation consulting, customer onboarding, or a similar customer-facing delivery role.
* Demonstrated experience hands-on configuring a SaaS platform based on documented business requirements or solution designs.
* Proven experience independently managing customer implementations from configuration through UAT, go-live, and handoff.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent customer projects with competing priorities, dependencies, stakeholders, and deadlines.
* Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate approved requirements into accurate system configuration.
* Strong judgment and the ability to recognize when a customer request represents a normal configuration decision versus a material change to an approved solution.
* Experience working with customer datasets using Excel or Google Sheets, including data validation, transformation, mapping, filtering, pivoting, and troubleshooting.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with an ability to create structure, maintain momentum, and drive accountability.
* Excellent customer-facing communication and facilitation skills, including the confidence to lead meetings, ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explain complex workflows in practical terms.
* Strong problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguity without waiting for someone else to provide every answer.
* Demonstrated ability to identify implementation risks early and drive decisions toward resolution.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities, processes, and products continue to evolve.
* A genuine passion for customer experience and helping customers successfully adopt new technology.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience implementing financial, ERP, accounting, planning, supply chain, retail, or other workflow-heavy SaaS products.
* Experience working with ERP systems, integrations, APIs, data migrations, or system-to-system workflows.
* Experience in consumer packaged goods (CPG), retail, trade promotion management (TPM), sales planning, finance, or accounting.
* Experience leading UAT, customer training, and change-management activities.
* Experience using AI or automation to improve implementation workflows, documentation, data preparation, configuration QA, or project efficiency.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first several months, you'll be able to independently take an approved customer solution and:

* Turn it into an accurate, operational Vividly configuration.
* Confidently lead the customer through their implementation plan and maintain momentum toward go-live.
* Manage multiple implementations simultaneously without sacrificing quality or customer experience.
* Understand enough of the customer's business process to explain why the platform is being configured a certain way—not simply how to configure it.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and potential design changes before they create downstream rework.
* Know when to make a configuration decision independently and when to bring Solution Architecture or another specialist back into the conversation.
* Prepare customers for successful go-live and provide Customer Success and Managed Services with a clean, structured handoff.
* Consistently deliver implementations that are on time, within scope, and positioned for long-term customer adoption and value.

**Why Choose Vividly?**

**A modern, remote-first workplace**

We are committed to succeeding as a fully remote team, empowering you with the flexibility to thrive, no commute required. Every Vividly team member receives a stipend upon hire to help create a comfortable, productive home office.

**Vividly days off & flexible PTO**

For most USA holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, we turn it into a 4 day weekend! Vividly also offers Flexible Time Off (*and we really mean it*) to help prevent burn out and fuel creativity.

**Competitive Benefits**

* Healthcare, Dental and Vision - We cover 100% of your monthly premiums and 50% of all dependents
* 401(k) - With a 3% employer contribution
* Weekly $20 Sharebite Meal Stipend - For every meal you purchase, they donate a meal through Feeding America!
* Monthly $50 Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly $200 Remote Work Stipend

**Commitment to our values - The Vividly Code**

* **Kind Ambition** -We push boundaries with empathy and integrity
* **Keep It Real** - We are transparent, honest, and authentic
* **Customer Love** - We act as trusted advisors to our customers
* **Own It** - We take responsibility and drive outcomes
* **Urgency Wins** - We move quickly and focus on impact
* **Pull Together** - We collaborate to win as a team

**Please note:** Vividly will never request sensitive information such as your social security number, bank account information, or other non-publicly available information during the application and interview process. If an applicant is extended an offer of employment, such sensitive information will be requested at that time during the onboarding process. Vividly will never ask you to receive and ship packages or goods as part of the interview. Other practices to be on alert for:

* Contact initiated via unsolicited text message or cold call. Vividly does not follow up with candidates through instant messaging applications.
* Our Talent Acquisition team only corresponds from email addresses with the domain ‘@govividly.com’. If a generic email ID ending with Gmail/Yahoo or other domain is used while receiving a job offer or interview call, there is a likelihood of a scammer.
* While some of our jobs can be found on third party job sites, all of our current job opportunities and descriptions are posted on Vividly’s Careers page, or our official LinkedIn Company Page

The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has published helpful articles to help individuals learn more about protecting themselves from recruiting scams and financial fraud. If you believe you were a victim of such a scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agencies. Vividly is not responsible for any claims, liability, losses, damages, or expenses resulting from scammers or impersonators.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
80,000 - 100,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager (WMS & TMS)
jobs.description:
**Implementation Project Manager (WMS/TMS)**
============================================

**Location:** Remote – United States  
**Department:** Professional Services / Implementation  
**Salary Range:** $95,00–$115,000 annually

**About ShipHawk**
------------------

ShipHawk is a leading provider of warehouse and transportation management software, helping businesses streamline fulfillment operations, optimize shipping, and scale efficiently. Our technology empowers companies to simplify complex logistics processes and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

We're a growing team of passionate problem-solvers who thrive on collaboration, innovation, and delivering meaningful results for our customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for an experienced, highly organized, and customer-focused **Implementation Project Manager** to join our team.

In this role, you'll lead end-to-end implementations of ShipHawk's Warehouse Management System (WMS) and Transportation Management System (TMS) solutions, ensuring customers are set up for success from kickoff through go-live.

You'll own multiple customer implementations simultaneously, coordinating technical resources, managing timelines, and serving as the primary point of contact throughout the implementation journey.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced SaaS environment, takes ownership of outcomes, and knows how to keep complex projects moving forward. You'll be equally comfortable leading customer conversations, managing project details, and collaborating with technical teams to deliver successful implementations.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Lead Customer Implementations**

* Own and manage multiple concurrent WMS and TMS implementation projects from kickoff through successful go-live.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
* Proactively manage dependencies, identify risks, and remove roadblocks to keep projects on track.
* Ensure implementations are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with customer expectations.

**Own Customer Communication & Relationships**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the implementation process.
* Lead customer kickoff meetings, status updates, and project discussions with clear agendas, action items, and next steps.
* Provide proactive, transparent communication regarding project progress, timelines, risks, and deliverables.
* Set clear expectations and build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders.
* Identify and escalate potential challenges early while maintaining a solutions-oriented approach.

**Drive Project Execution & Accountability**

* Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date project documentation, task tracking, and status reports.
* Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
* Follow up on outstanding action items and drive accountability across project teams.
* Anticipate potential delays and develop actionable contingency plans to keep implementations moving forward.
* Balance competing priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail across multiple projects.

**Partner with Technical Teams**

* Collaborate closely with Implementation Engineers, Product, and other internal teams to support successful deployments.
* Perform or coordinate system configuration, data setup, integrations, testing, and validation activities.
* Develop a strong understanding of ShipHawk's WMS and TMS solutions and how they support customer operations.
* Help troubleshoot implementation challenges by bringing together the right technical resources.
* Ensure customers are prepared for go-live through appropriate testing, validation, and readiness activities.

**Continuously Improve**

* Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, documentation, and customer experiences.
* Share best practices and lessons learned across the team.
* Contribute to scalable implementation methodologies that support ShipHawk's continued growth.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical project management, or customer-facing software delivery.
* Proven experience managing multiple complex customer implementation projects simultaneously.
* Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence leading customer-facing meetings.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a track record of meeting deadlines and driving projects to completion.
* Comfortable working with technical concepts, software configurations, data workflows, and integrations.
* Self-starter mentality with a high level of accountability, initiative, and ownership.
* Ability to adapt quickly, solve problems independently, and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), ERP platforms, or other supply chain technology.
* Understanding of warehouse operations, order fulfillment, inventory management, shipping, or logistics workflows.
* Experience working with APIs, EDI, system integrations, or data migration processes.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana, Jira, Monday.com, or similar platforms.
* Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
* PMP, CSM, or other relevant project management certifications.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* **Successful Go-Lives:** Customer implementations are delivered on time, within scope, and with a smooth transition to production.
* **Strong Customer Experience:** Customers feel informed, supported, and confident throughout their implementation journey.
* **Proactive Project Ownership:** Risks are identified early, action items are consistently followed through, and projects continue moving forward.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:** Internal teams and customer stakeholders have clear expectations, responsibilities, and timelines.
* **Operational Excellence:** Project documentation is accurate, deliverables are tracked, and implementation processes continuously improve.

**Why Join ShipHawk?**
----------------------

At ShipHawk, you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on how businesses manage their warehouse and shipping operations. You'll work alongside a collaborative team, solve meaningful operational challenges, and play an important role in delivering technology that helps our customers grow.

We value people who take initiative, communicate openly, embrace challenges, and take pride in delivering exceptional results.

**Compensation**
----------------

The base salary range for this position is **$95,000–$115,000 annually**. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and relevant expertise.

***Equal Employment Opportunity***
----------------------------------

*ShipHawk is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

*Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities throughout the hiring process and employment.*

Description:

**Summary**

ACES Quality Management is on a mission to enable organizations to improve quality, reduce risk, strengthen compliance, and operate with confidence by delivering advanced technology. Through our leading quality management platform, we empower clients to elevate performance and stay ahead of risk. What sets us apart is our people - an engaged, high-performing, remote team that shows up for our customers and each other every day.

The Implementation Support Specialist tests and validates new and updated platform logic, working in close collaboration with the Compliance Business Analyst to confirm that reporting and compliance logic performs as intended before release. This role requires strong analytical ability, comfort working independently, and a solid understanding of how logic and data structures function. The Implementation Support Specialist plays a key quality assurance role within the implementation process, catching issues early and ensuring a smooth, accurate rollout for clients.

**Essential Functions / Responsibilities**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

* Conducts quality assurance and inline testing of new and updated platform logic, reporting functionality, and data sets
* Partners closely with the Compliance Business Analyst to understand the intent of new or updated logic and design appropriate test scenarios
* Identifies, documents, and tracks defects or discrepancies, working with internal teams to resolve them prior to release
* Validates that logic and data outputs align with underlying business and regulatory requirements
* Executes structured test plans and ad hoc testing to confirm functionality across a range of scenarios and edge cases
* Works independently to prioritize and manage testing workload against implementation timelines
* Documents test results, defects, and resolutions clearly for internal reference
* Supports the broader implementation and client success teams during rollout of new or updated functionality
* Performs specialized training with clients as part of the onboarding process
* Participates in professional services engagements to build out client custom policies
* Contributes to internal knowledge base articles and best-practice documentation related to testing and quality assurance

Requirements:

**Qualifications & Competencies**

* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail
* Ability to work effectively and independently with minimal oversight
* Solid understanding of how logic, data structures, and rule sets function
* Background in quality assurance (QA) and inline/manual testing practices
* Ability to identify, document, and communicate defects clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational and time management skills; able to manage multiple test cycles effectively
* Familiarity with ticketing systems
* Working knowledge of the ACES platform preferred

**Required Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college preferred, or equivalent work experience
* 1–3 years of experience in quality assurance, testing, implementation support, or a related technical support role
* Demonstrated experience with inline/manual testing and validating data- or logic-driven outputs
* Foundational understanding of mortgage servicing, loan origination, or core banking systems preferred
* Experience supporting SaaS-based applications or cloud-hosted platforms preferred

**Travel Required**

0%–5% travel. Potential travel includes MBA or other industry conferences and ACES Quality Management sponsored events such as ACES Engage.

**Other Duties**

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, Automotive SaaS
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**

At myKaarma, we’re not just leading the way in fixed ops solutions for the automotive industry—we’re redefining what’s possible for dealership service centers. Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and powered by a global team, our industry-leading SaaS platform combines communication, scheduling, and payment tools in one seamless solution that keeps dealerships and vehicle owners connected. With myKaarma, every service interaction flows effortlessly, bringing good karma to customers and service teams.

Rooted in the principles of the Toyota Production System, we operate with precision, efficiency, and a relentless focus on continuous improvement to deliver a better experience for all. We’re looking for innovators, problem-solvers, and tech enthusiasts passionate about building solutions people love to use. If you’re ready to make an impact in an industry ripe for change, join us at myKaarma and help shape the future of automotive service.

At myKaarma, exceptional customer interactions are the cornerstone of our success. Our platform is meticulously engineered to communicate with customers at every aspect of the service, repair, and maintenance journey, ensuring positive and memorable experiences.

### **Role Description**

As an **Implementation Specialist** at myKaarma, you will own the technical configuration and implementation readiness of our service scheduling, digital check-in, and vehicle inspection solutions. You will partner directly with automotive dealership customers to understand their service workflows, operational needs, existing technology, and integration dependencies—then translate those requirements into reliable, scalable solutions.

You will serve as a technical escalation resource throughout the implementation process, resolving complex configuration challenges, confirming infrastructure readiness, and testing the complete customer journey before training begins. Working closely with Deployment Managers and the Training Team, you will ensure each solution is fully configured and prepared for a successful launch. You will also develop documentation, templates, automations, and repeatable processes that improve implementation efficiency and create a consistent customer experience.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Guide automotive dealership customers through the setup of myKaarma’s service scheduling, digital check-in, and vehicle inspection tools, ensuring each solution is configured to support the dealership’s specific business needs.
* Lead detailed discovery sessions to understand each dealership’s current workflows, operating processes, and existing technology, including any systems that myKaarma will replace.
* Confirm that each assigned dealership has the required devices, network connectivity, and technical infrastructure in place well before implementation or onsite training begins.
* Test and demonstrate the configured solution with the customer before training, walking through the full service experience from appointment scheduling and customer arrival through vehicle inspection and service completion.
* Coordinate closely with the Deployment Manager and Training Team to communicate customer requirements, resolve configuration issues, and ensure each product is fully prepared for onsite or remote training.
* Develop templates, automations, and repeatable processes that make product setup more efficient, reduce manual administrative work, and allow more time for meaningful customer consultation.

### **Qualifications and Skills**

* 2+ years of experience in software implementation, deployment, customer onboarding, or a similar client-facing role.
* Experience working in automotive, Software as a Service (SaaS), or another technology-enabled service environment.
* Strong communication and customer consultation skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear system requirements.
* Self-directed and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple customer implementations, priorities, and deadlines.
* Comfortable using business tools such as Salesforce and Google Workspace, including Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Forms, and related applications.
* General understanding of software implementation processes and customer service best practices.

**Preferred/Nice-to-Have:**

* Experience working in automotive dealership service operations, such as service scheduling, customer check-in, repair orders, or vehicle inspections.
* Experience implementing or supporting software used by automotive dealerships.
* Familiarity with myKaarma products or similar dealership technology platforms.

This position works under the direction of the Senior Manager of Call Center Operations with strong collaboration with the Learning and Development Team.

* Create, maintain and present training materials for Member/Provider Services, including training of staff handling inbound and outbound calls, staff processing incoming electronic enrollments and complaints, grievances and appeals

* Design, lead and review Member/Provider Service, end-users training on Neighborhood’s core system applications or tools through classroom instruction and one-on-one training/coaching.
* Create and maintain end to end training materials by Line of Business that is consistent with the training approach approves.
* Introduce to new Member/Provider Services staff members and increase existing staff members understanding and utilization of core system software applications
* Provide education on health plan benefits, and billing guidelines and how access the necessary online benefit information.
* In coordination with the leadership teams within Member/Provider Services ensure proper workflow is maintained within the department and between internal/external customers.

* Create and adapt training curriculum as needed for different audiences
* Works collaboratively with Neighborhood’s Learning and Development team, using training support systems approved by Neighborhood.

* Works collaboratively with Neighborhood’s Learning and Development Team.

jobs.title: Implementation Support Specialist - Special Projects
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated Implementation Support Specialist to join our team and act as a friendly, forward-facing resource for participants, caregivers, and care staff for our special projects, namely: THRIVE@Home. In this project, older adults aging in place will be using our Rendever VR platform to connect with residents of local senior living communities, helping to reduce social isolation and improve wellbeing. This project is kicking off in October 2026 and is supported by an incredible team, and we’re excited to add this role to help participants and their support networks navigate any potential challenges that arise as our platform is used in more diverse settings.

The Implementation Support Specialist is responsible for helping customers, participants, and caregivers troubleshoot issues with their Rendever system, coordinating the setup and scheduling of training calls, maintaining records of technical support interactions, and collaborating with others to improve the company's overall technical support capabilities. During the first six months, the Specialist will focus on shadowing our experienced VR Support Specialist and assisting with participant training, gradually transitioning to primarily supporting study participants and their care teams. Execution and an operational mindset are essential for success in this role.

If you’re unafraid to lean into the unknown and find solutions to technical user challenges, and you find excitement in learning about cutting-edge technology, you’ve come to the right place! Of course, we’re certain you’ll be a part of collecting some pretty incredible moments of impact each day, and can’t wait to see the stories come in.

Roles & responsibilities

* Support the setup and deployment of study systems, including tracking system deliveries and scheduling training calls.
* Act as the first point of contact for all inbound technical support requests from study participants, caregivers, and members of their care team.
* Navigate troubleshooting requests to resolution, and communicate solutions and next steps to both internal and participants in a clear, patient, and accessible manner.
* Write and deliver Bug Logs that clearly details steps to reproduce the bug, the overall impact on system usage, and assign severity level for the issue
* Work collaboratively with the Research, Community Engagement, and Product teams to ensure that all technical issues are resolved in a timely manner, and relevant feedback is shared and integrated into the product roadmap
* Manage communications with communities, participants, and families, ensuring we maintain the proactive and responsive delivery time that our brand is known for

  
**Requirements**

**Customer service:**

As Rendever’s first point of contact for technical support, your customer service skills will be used to put customers at ease and help them solve their technical problems

**Planning:**

Organizing tasks and coordinating schedules for system deliveries, training calls, and support requests ensures you can manage daily responsibilities from beginning to end.

**Communication skills:**

Excellent listening and verbal communication skills are required to understand concerns from participants, caregivers, and care staff and clearly explain technical solutions to people with varying levels of comfort and experience with technology.

**Technical Support Skills:**

Strong technical support skills are required in this role. Familiarity and interest in working with and helping others use computers and other technology remotely is vital to success. Having a passion of understanding new technology will help the Implementation Support Specialist succeed when working with participants who are using experimental technology, which will many times not have straightforward a previously documented solutions. troubleshoot VR hardware and software issues.

**Time management:**

You’ll use time management skills to prioritize technical support requests, training calls, and system set up priorities quickly, allowing you to address all department expectations.

**Problem-solving skills:**

Leveraging problem-solving skills to diagnose technical issues, guide participants, caregivers, and care staff through solutions, and escalate concerns when necessary. Problem solving skills are vital in this role, as you discover new technical issues for the first time, and work with the proper team to get them resolved, and the systems up and running again as soon as possible.

 **Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Short Term & Long Term Disability
* Work From Home
* Stock Option Plan

jobs.title: EMR Platform Owner
jobs.description:
Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments. Our board-certified physicians and expert staff are on a mission to improve people's quality of life by relieving the painful, yet highly treatable symptoms of vein disease—such as varicose veins and heavy, aching legs.

With over **70 clinics across 9 states**, and still growing, we're building the future of vein care—delivering compassionate, results-driven care in a modern, patient-first environment.

We proudly maintain a **Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93**, the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

**About Metro Vein Centers**
----------------------------

Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing, multi-site specialty healthcare organization focused on delivering exceptional patient care through operational excellence, technology enablement, and scalable clinical systems.

We are modernizing our enterprise EMR and clinical systems ecosystem to support the next phase of growth across clinical operations, patient experience, revenue cycle, analytics, and workflow automation.

We are seeking a highly operational, systems-oriented leader to serve as the long-term owner of our EMR platform and adjacent clinical systems infrastructure.

This is not a traditional healthcare IT administration role.

The ideal candidate thinks like a product owner and operator — someone who can continuously improve how care delivery functions through technology, workflows, automation, and operational design.

**The Role**
------------

As the EMR Platform Owner, you will own the strategy, evolution, optimization, and governance of Metro Vein Centers' enterprise EMR and clinical systems ecosystem.

You will lead the organization's EMR modernization initiative while serving as the long-term operational owner of the platform after implementation.

This role sits at the intersection of:

* clinical operations,
* provider experience,
* revenue cycle,
* systems architecture,
* workflow optimization,
* analytics,
* and operational scalability.

You will partner closely with leadership across operations, clinical teams, billing, analytics, and technology to ensure the EMR functions as a scalable operational platform for the business.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Platform Ownership & Strategy**

* Own the long-term roadmap for the enterprise EMR and clinical systems ecosystem
* Define and continuously improve future-state workflows across clinical operations, scheduling, intake, documentation, billing, and patient engagement
* Establish governance standards for EMR workflows, configurations, integrations, and operational change management
* Evaluate platform capabilities, integrations, and optimization opportunities
* Serve as the primary business owner for the EMR and related operational systems

### **EMR Modernization Leadership**

* Lead the organization's EMR transition initiative from vendor selection through implementation and post-go-live optimization
* Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across operations, clinical teams, revenue cycle, analytics, and technology
* Partner with external consultants, implementation vendors, and EMR partners
* Drive implementation planning, migration readiness, workflow alignment, testing, adoption, and stabilization activities
* Ensure operational continuity and provider adoption throughout the transition
* Coordinate legacy EMR wind-down efforts, including transition planning, data archival needs, vendor communication, and post-conversion support.

### **Operational Workflow Optimization**

* Partner with clinical and operational leadership to improve provider workflows, clinic throughput, documentation efficiency, and operational consistency
* Identify opportunities to reduce administrative friction and automate manual workflows
* Collaborate with revenue cycle leadership to optimize authorizations, coding, billing, denial management, and eligibility workflows
* Standardize workflows across clinics while balancing operational flexibility where appropriate
* Develop KPI frameworks and operational reporting tied to platform performance

### **Systems & Data Ecosystem**

* Partner with analytics and engineering teams to support reporting, interoperability, and data governance initiatives
* Manage relationships with EMR vendors and third-party integration partners
* Support scalable onboarding of future clinics, providers, and acquisitions
* Help shape long-term enterprise architecture decisions related to clinical systems and operational platforms
* Own system administration and governance (in partnership with IT Director), including SOPs around user security access, role-based permissions, system updates, configuration changes, enhancement requests, and ongoing optimization to ensure platforms remain secure, compliant, and aligned with business needs.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required Experience**

* Experience owning, leading, or optimizing EMR/EHR platforms in a multi-site ambulatory healthcare environment
* Strong operational mindset with demonstrated experience improving workflows and systems adoption
* Experience working cross-functionally with clinical operations, revenue cycle, analytics, and technical teams
* Ability to translate operational challenges into scalable systems solutions
* Experience leading or supporting complex healthcare technology implementations or transformations

### **Preferred Experience**

* Specialty practice or ambulatory care experience strongly preferred
* Experience with EMR migrations or enterprise platform modernization initiatives
* Experience in high-growth or multi-site healthcare organizations
* Familiarity with healthcare operations KPIs, revenue cycle workflows, and provider productivity metrics
* Experience working with integrations, APIs, reporting ecosystems, or operational analytics platforms

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role**
----------------------------------------------

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Think in systems, workflows, and operational leverage
* Enjoy solving ambiguous cross-functional problems
* Can balance clinical, operational, financial, and technical priorities
* Are equally comfortable working with executives, physicians, operators, analysts, and technical teams
* Prefer building scalable operational platforms over maintaining legacy workflows
* Thrive in fast-moving, high-growth environments
* Bring a product-owner mentality to operational systems and platform governance

**What This Role Is Not**
-------------------------

This role is not:

* a traditional EMR administrator role,
* a helpdesk or infrastructure IT role,
* or a pure project/program management function.

This role is intended to serve as the long-term operational owner of the organization's clinical systems platform and care delivery workflows.

**Why Join Metro Vein Centers**
-------------------------------

This role offers a rare opportunity to help shape the operational infrastructure of a rapidly scaling healthcare organization.

You will have direct influence over:

* how providers deliver care,
* how clinics operate,
* how patients engage with the organization,
* and how technology enables future growth across the enterprise.

You will help define the next generation of operational systems powering Metro Vein Centers.

  

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary (starts at $120,000) and benefits
* High-growth environment with ownership and autonomy
* Smart, collaborative, creative teammates
* Real impact on business performance and patient experience

**The Metro Vein Centers Difference**

**Healthy legs. Happier lives.**  
At Metro Vein Centers, we believe exceptional care begins with an exceptional experience. Our mission is to make vein care approachable, empowering, and connected to overall well-being. From the first conversation to the final follow-up, every patient interaction reflects our commitment to compassion, expertise, and trust.

**A team united by purpose.**  
Our values guide everything we do:

* **Patients First, Always** – Every interaction should make our patients feel valued, heard, and cared for.
* **Stronger Together** – Teamwork and collaboration drive our success. We lift each other up to deliver the best for our patients.
* **A Can-Do Spirit** – We meet every challenge with positivity, flexibility, and problem-solving energy.
* **Results That Make a Difference** – We're driven to improve lives through meaningful, measurable outcomes.
* **Commitment to Growth** – We invest in our people, fostering advancement and professional development at every level.

**Metro Vein Centers is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**  
We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels seen, heard, and supported. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

**Legal & Compliance Notice:**  
Metro Vein Centers complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, including those related to nondiscrimination, equal opportunity, and pay transparency. Where specific disclosures or postings are required by law, we provide this information as part of our hiring process or upon request.

**Your privacy matters.**  
To learn more about how we collect, use, and protect your information, please review our privacy policy here.

jobs.title: Member Support Specialist, Escalations & Grievances
jobs.description:
**About us:**  
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the role:**

This role serves as the final point of contact for complex member issues, including health plan grievances, RD grievances, and advanced member account support and food benefits escalations. This individual is responsible for resolving highly sensitive situations that require strong judgment, cross-functional coordination, and nuanced communication with members, health plans, and internal stakeholders.

The ideal candidate brings advanced critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and the ability to tackle advanced issues while ensuring members and RDs feel heard, supported, and respected.

### **You will:**

Escalations & Grievance Management

* Own and resolve high-priority, complex, or sensitive member escalations end-to-end.
* Own all escalations and grievances relating to RDs end to end, and collaborate with the Clinical Operations team to manage and document these effectively.
* Investigate RD reports of member behavior and safety concerns.
* Serve as the “last line” point of contact for unresolved member concerns in their scope.
* Investigate escalated or complex member and internal requests relating to member profile and food benefit issues.
* Ensure timely, compliant, and well-documented resolution of all escalations.

Cross-Functional & External Communication

* Communicate professionally and clearly with health plans, providers, and external partners.
* Adapt communication style based on audience (members, executives, clinical and member support teams, partners).
* Translate complex issues into actionable insights for internal stakeholders.
* Manage and escalate benefit and account issues to the engineering and product team, and manage ongoing requests and projects with these groups.

De-escalation & Member Experience

* Lead de-escalation efforts with empathy, professionalism, and control.
* Maintain communication standards by monitoring the quality of communication around benefit programs and account issues between member support and members.
* Ensure internal and external resources outlining benefits programs are current and accurate.

Judgment & Decision-Making

* Make independent, high-stakes decisions within established guidelines.
* Identify when to escalate issues further vs. resolve directly.
* Recognize patterns and recommend improvements to reduce future escalations.

### **You are:**

* **Advanced Critical Thinker**: Ability to assess complex, ambiguous situations and determine the best course of action.
* **Agile in Communication**: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor tone and messaging across audiences.
* **Sound Judgment**: Trusted to make decisions on sensitive accommodation and escalation cases.
* **De-escalation & Mediation Minded**: Proven ability to manage high-emotion interactions and drive resolution.
* **Empathetic with Authorit**y: Can create a supportive experience while maintaining control and direction of the conversation.
* **Detail Orientated**: Strong documentation and compliance mindset, especially with sensitive or regulated processes.
* **Technically Proficient**: Established acumen for technically intricate situations, and capable of communicating effectively with product and engineering teams .

### **You have:**

* Reliable high speed internet access with minimum speeds of roughly 100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload.
* A completely private, secure, and quiet workspace.
* 1–3+ years in member/patient support, escalations, grievances, or case management.
* Experience working with health plans, healthcare systems, or regulated environments preferred.
* Demonstrated experience handling complex escalations or complaint resolution.
* Experience working in technically complex roles.

### **Success in this role looks like:**

* Complex escalations are resolved efficiently and thoughtfully.
* Members and RDs feel heard and supported—even in difficult situations.
* Health plan and partner communications are clear, professional, and effective.
* Trends in escalations are identified and fed back to improve the overall member experience.
* Emerging product and engineering issues are escalated in a timely manner, and ongoing issues are contributed to and closely monitored.

jobs.title: EHR Integration Specialist
jobs.description:
**JOB SPECIFICATION – EHR INTEGRATION SPECIALIST**

Reports to: Director of EHR Integration

Classification: Exempt, Full-Time

Location: Remote in United States

**COMPANY OVERVIEW:**  
  
RMX Holdco, Inc. and Subsidiaries (AKA “RhythMedix” or the “Company”) is a rapidly growing provider of remote cardiac monitoring services. The Company focuses on improving patient care through the use of patient-friendly devices and mobile communications to diagnose and treat heart disease faster.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

We are seeking a skilled EHR Integration Specialist to lead the deployment, configuration, and management of data interfaces between our cardiac device monitoring platform and healthcare providers' Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.

In this role, you will be the core technical owner of our integration pipeline. You will ensure that vital cardiac monitoring reports seamlessly and securely flow into clinical charts. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience building custom interface pathways using Mirth Connect, writing production-grade JavaScript, and working directly with hospital IT teams from a remote environment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Interface Development: Build, configure, and maintain robust, high-availability integration workflows using the Mirth Connect interface engine.
* Custom Scripting: Write clean, efficient JavaScript scripts within Mirth to handle complex data transformations, filtering, and custom routing logic.
* Database Management: Query, update, and manage relational databases using SQL to validate data integrity and track interface performance metrics.
* Standards Mapping: Design and map interface payloads utilizing HL7 (v2/v3) messaging standards and emerging FHIR APIs.
* Deployment & Testing: Lead remote end-to-end testing cycles with hospital IT personnel, validating interface configurations in test environments before driving them to production.
* Tier 3 Support: Serve as the technical point of contact to troubleshoot and resolve advanced interface dropouts, database connection issues, or transmission failures.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience working in Healthcare IT with a focus on EHR system integrations.
* Core Interface Skills: Proven, practical experience developing and managing channels within the Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect) integration engine.
* Programming: Proficiency in JavaScript for writing custom transformers, filters, and scripts within an integration environment.
* Healthcare Standards: Deep understanding of HL7 messaging structures and interface protocols (TCP/IP, LLP, SFTP, VPN).
* Remote Work: Proven ability to work independently in a fully remote environment, managing multiple hospital deployment timelines effectively.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Health Informatics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Database Skills: Solid experience writing SQL queries and managing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL).
* Domain Knowledge: Prior experience working with cardiac device clinics, electrophysiology data, or remote medical device monitoring workflows.
* Professional certifications in HL7/FHIR or vendor-specific EHR badges (e.g., Epic Bridges).

**BENEFITS:**

* Competitive salary and bonus structure
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings plan - 401(k) - with company match
